_comment: Records the upstream HEAD SHA we last AUDITED for each credited repo. We absorb (rewrite/expand) upstream skills into our roster — we do not fork or mirror them — so this is a drift DETECTOR, not a sync. Run scripts/upstream-drift.sh to see what changed upstream since these SHAs; triage, absorb anything worthwhile via the audit -> absorb -> smoke-test workflow, then run with --update to re-baseline.
